first.rationale: Onboarding simplification directly addresses both deteriorating onboarding completion and activation, with two inherited records indicating faster time-to-value and durable activation gains. Promotional pricing is the strongest alternative given competitor pressure, but its effects on long-term customer quality and retention should be verified before prioritizing it against the primary objective of sustainable qualified revenue.

final.rationale: Run a controlled onboarding-simplification experiment. The confirmed shortened-flow result directly addresses the current 4% completion decline while improving time-to-value and 30-day retention. SMB signup simplification also lifted activation and qualified revenue, though its slight retention decline and segment limitation warrant guardrails and segmented analysis. Reject promotional pricing despite acquisition lift because the verified cohort suffered a 12% retention decline and failed to survive first renewal, conflicting with sustainable long-term qualified revenue.
